title: 349 calibrate verified native tool results on the original upgrade
description: Unscored, independently started Commons Text PR 586 calibration under the pre-lock correction for native tool result representation. The ordinary stock CLI can append a reminder to an intact tool result or store an oversized result in the current native session. The corrected meter binds the exact result and tool-use ID in each case. Use the same released source trees, original ordered JARs, role models, subject root and complete end-to-end limits. Preserve the original two first reports and any failure in the new admission check.
expected: A new immutable original-input first report with a verified result or an honest first blocker and a separately hashed terminal admission record. Receipt collection is independent of the application verdict.

resources.notes: Earlier planning-only runs took seconds to a few minutes. This treatment may reach native proof. The shared PR cap is 250000 uncached input plus output tokens, four CPUs, 16 GiB and two hours starting at intake.

steps.name: Run the amended native metering profile with a fresh role and seal its result
